name: Musee
source:
Profession: God does not work
Country: The Origin of Mankind, Gaia
Race: God of Destruction
Height: God is small
Breast size: God is small

Gaia, the birthplace of humankind, has become a dark and desolate which keeps people away due to the subsequent climate change. Deep in this dark land, a great mage kept praying to the earth. Finally, in exchange for his life, he summoned the god of destruction. But the destructive god was...small. 

Originally, she couldn't wake up until 100 million years had passed, but it seems that this happened for unusual reasons. Because she is small, she does not have her original destructive power. However, after waking up, she decided to have a great child with the hero so she can destroy the world with it.

"Okay, I will give birth to your child. That's the duty of a god of destruction."
